## cargoship_reset

Remove the cluster from the fleet.

Write it as `colonel_byte.cargoship.cargoship_reset`. It runs on the management node; nothing is installed on the fleet.

Runs `cargoship reset` against the fleet described by an Ansible inventory.

There is no package: it removes what is installed, and the distro to remove is named directly rather than read out of one. It installs nothing, so it takes no values and no signature parameters.

### Parameters

| Parameter             | Type            | Required | Flag                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | --------------- | -------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `inventory`           | `dict`          | yes      | None                 | The resolved Ansible inventory the module translates into a ZarfCluster document: `groups`, `hostvars`, and a `cluster` block. The action plugin fills `groups` and `hostvars` in from the play, so a task normally sets only `cluster`. Renders no flag of its own. The translated document is passed to the command as `--config`. |
| `parameters`          | `dict`          | no       | None                 | Further module parameters, merged into the ones given directly. It is how the `cluster` role passes a caller-supplied set without templating a whole task's arguments. A parameter given both directly and inside `parameters` is an error naming it. The action plugin consumes this key; the module never sees it.                 |
| `distro`              | `str`           | no       | `--distro`           | The distro to remove. One of `k3s`, `rke2`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `concurrency`         | `int`           | no       | `--concurrency`      | How many hosts to work on at once.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `work_concurrency`    | `str`           | no       | `--work-concurrency` | How much work to run concurrently on each host. A count or a percentage, as a string.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `hosts`               | `bool`          | no       | `--hosts`            | Whether to manage `/etc/hosts` entries on the fleet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `firewall`            | `bool`          | no       | `--firewall`         | Whether to manage the host firewall on the fleet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `fapolicyd`           | `bool`          | no       | `--fapolicyd`        | Whether to manage fapolicyd rules on the fleet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `inventory_path`      | `str`           | no       | `--config`           | Where to write the generated ZarfCluster document. A private temporary file when unset, removed after a run that succeeded. A run that fails leaves the document on disk either way, because it is the first thing to look at when a failure reads like the wrong cluster.                                                           |
| `age_recipient`       | `list` of `str` | no       | None                 | Age public keys used to encrypt registry credentials written into the generated inventory document. Consumed while that document is written, so it renders no flag.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `age_recipients_file` | `list` of `str` | no       | None                 | Files holding age public keys, read for the same purpose as `age_recipient`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `log_level`           | `str`           | no       | `--log-level`        | Cargoship's log level. Defaults to `debug` when the play runs with `-v`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `log_format`          | `str`           | no       | `--log-format`       | Cargoship's log format.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `log_file`            | `bool`          | no       | `--log-file`         | Whether to always write a full-verbosity debug log to a file on the management node, regardless of log level.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

### Notes

- Set `run_once: true` and `delegate_to` on the task. Cargoship converges the whole fleet in a single run, so a play over the fleet's own inventory would otherwise converge it once per host.
- Set `no_log: true` on the task. A binary module has no per-parameter `no_log`, so the task-level setting is what suppresses the arguments and the result.
- A parameter left unset renders no flag, so whatever the cargoship configuration file sets still applies. That is why `label_nodes: false` and omitting `label_nodes` differ.

### Example

```yaml
- name: Remove the cluster
  colonel_byte.cargoship.cargoship_reset:
    distro: rke2
    inventory:
      cluster:
        name: bubbles
        loadbalancer: bubbles-kc.test.com
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
  no_log: true
```
